name: Cessna Citation I (500/501)
summary: The original Citation, a slow, forgiving light jet nicknamed the 'Slowtation' that launched Cessna's long-running business-jet line.

wings: Low, essentially straight wing with a short span
engines: Two small Pratt & Whitney Canada JT15D turbofans in pods on the rear fuselage
fuselage: Small, slim fuselage with a short row of small windows
tail: Swept fin with a low-set horizontal stabilizer (not a T-tail)

tellTales: Small light jet with straight, unswept wings
Low-set tailplane on a swept fin, not a T-tail
Short row of small windows on a small, slim fuselage

confusedWith.howToTell: The Citation II/Bravo is longer with a longer-span wing and more cabin windows; the Citation I is the smaller, shorter-winged original.
The CitationJet has a T-tail; the Citation I has a low-set tailplane.
The Mustang is a newer design with sleek, smaller engine pods and a smoothly curved nose; the Citation I looks older, with a longer, drooped nose and larger pods.
The Learjet has a swept wing with tip tanks and a T-tail; the Citation I has a straight wing and a low-set tailplane.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
